meta.name: exploratory-data-analysis
meta.description: Perform bounded, local exploratory analysis of explicitly supported scientific files. Use for redacted CSV/TSV/JSON profiles; optional NumPy, HDF5, FASTA/FASTQ, and basic image metadata inspection; missingness/leakage audits; outlier and transformation sensitivity; and rigorous EDA report scaffolds. Other domain formats are reference-only and unknown formats fail closed.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 快速探查科学数据文件，找出缺失值、异常并生成探索报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果拿到新数据集想先全面摸底,再决定如何处理与分析
copy.tagline_en: Inspect your scientific datasets for missing values, outliers, and key patterns
copy.fit_line_en: For you if in need of a quick data sanity check before deeper analysis

howto.what: 把科学数据文件路径交给 Claude,它会识别文件类型,做对应的检查(表格看缺失值、统计量与异常值;序列看条数与 GC 含量;图像看维度与元数据),然后生成一份 Markdown 报告,存为「原文件名_eda_report.md」。
howto.when: 当你给出一个科学数据文件的路径,并要求「探索」「分析」或「总结」它,或想先了解它的结构、质量与完整性时触发;不认识的扩展名会先向你确认格式。

howto.what_en: Point Claude at a scientific data file: it detects the type, runs type-specific checks (missing values, statistics, outliers; sequence counts; image metadata), and writes a Markdown report saved as <filename>_eda_report.md.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you give a path to a scientific data file and ask to explore, analyze or summarize it, or want to know its structure and quality first. Unknown extensions prompt a format question.
